section: Every problem found this fall, and its fix
rows: Every let-bound function took the recursive path; passes multiplied with nesting, 4depth
nested lets 400 s → 0.6 s; statics 20–30% faster
Jump to a projector walked the caret token by token
Loading text the fast parser rejects: quadratic fallback parser (finding 1)
corpus 1,242 s → 433 s (both); Kids' Choice 227 → 93 s
Each run shipped the whole incremental cache to and from the worker
Elaborations carried the source's whitespace and comments
1.8 s of a slide's 4.2 s statics
A livelit definition analyzed twice (synthesis, then analysis)
Firefox: worker couldn't start while the page was busy; late timers killed it
Statics re-ran 3× per edit (probe pins compared to the wrong keys)
The builtin Html type written out in every ascription; Macro uses closed over all builtins
Every livelit use evaluated the whole livelit definition, then copied it unshared
Statics analyzes some expressions 3× per multiplier: recursive lets, shadowing a builtin, a label on an unannotated parameter (finding 10)
B2T2 programs up to 12× per expression; 3d for nested recursion
The evaluator compared two copies of the Html sum type, a full meet, at every node of a view
Livelit definitions and views were "finished": every helper copied into every closure, per event and per redraw
A projector update re-made every piece of the program, so per-item parsing re-parsed all of it
Every redraw evaluated every livelit's view, changed or not
The worker's reuse check compared every cached expression with the new one structurally; an edit inside many lets was walked to once per enclosing let
worker 410 → ~145 ms per release (profiled); dev benchmark 2.7 → 0.41 s
Each message from the eval worker was its own action, and the page rebuilds its view after every action: six redraws per slider release
Redraws that showed nothing new rebuilt sub-views from unchanged inputs: the code view (its cache keyed on a record rebuilt with every result), closed event handlers, printed probe values
#2635 51df91d5d7; #2597 a15af020ea (without the code-view part, which is #2469’s)
Cursor info rebuilt the program's source and compared it structurally on every redraw
The first slider release after a load re-parsed the whole program: loading filled a different parse cache from the one releases read
Every request sent the worker the whole program and its statics, though a release changes one value; the worker then had to find the unchanged parts again
request 478 → 18.5 KB; release to face 359 → 229–273 ms
Evaluation minted each id by copying a byte buffer and converting it to a string; ids, variable names and ints were compared with the polymorphic compare
face view evaluation ~61 → ~60 ms median, ~58.5 → ~53.5 min
Each recursive call of the evaluator re-applied it to the run's five constants: a closure per node, and every call through js_of_ocaml's generic path
The evaluator made its stages as eight fresh closures at every node, and two stages bound a step only to pass the value through
A view was evaluated whole after every change of its model, re-making the calls whose inputs had not changed
Collecting the worker's results re-indexed the whole program, function bodies and all, after every commit
44 → 6 ms profiled per release; release to face 195 / 203 → 163.5 / 179 ms
Each worker response was sent whole: a release's result was 393 KB, and marshaling it took as long as evaluating
result 393 → 16 KB; worker encode 44 → 5 ms profiled; #2597 release ~3.9 → 3.2 s
After each redraw, measuring the page forced three layouts and two document-wide style recalculations
Finding incomplete tiles walked the whole program for each redraw with new syntax (problems panel, outline)
Reusing a cached result walked the whole reused code to copy its descendants' cache entries, though function bodies never have any
worker evaluation 47 → 25 ms profiled (off the face's path)
The code editor re-checked every tile's sort on every commit, to decide which chunks to redraw, though only top-level and derivation tiles can change
#2635 31502d1e3d (the chunked code view is #2469's; not on #2597)
code editor 26 → 8 ms profiled; release to face −3–5 ms; mega-4k 25,852 → 270 tiles per commit
